title: Consumer Consent and Firm Targeting After GDPR: The Case of a Large Telecom Provider
eligible_reason: Household-month panel (Jan-Oct 2018) in which GDPR-compliant consent is re-elicited at two different dates: the 'Treated' group in July 2018 and the 'Control' group in August 2018. The treatment indicator switches on at those unit-specific dates and stays on; no household is never treated. Main specifications are static TWFE regressions with household and month FE, no controls, SEs clustered by household. Two adoption cohorts with the later cohort untreated in July satisfy the protocol's minimum. Eligibility is inferred from the synthetic replication data and the R code, not from the article text.
design_notes: R (lfe::felm) R-markdown replication_public.Rmd; data public_dataset.csv (synthetic: 10,000 households x 10 months = 100,000 rows; original has 33,629 households). In the synthetic data, treated first equals 1 in 201807 for 4,988 households (group=='Treated') and in 201808 for 5,012 (group=='Control'); no switch-offs; no never-treated households. Specification: felm(y ~ treated + factor(month_id) | id | 0 | id). Outcomes: four consent flags (Table 1), seven targeting/consumer-response outcomes (Table 3), three marketing-data-use counts (Table 7), plus subsample versions (Tables 2, 6, 8). Not eligible: Table 1/7 OLS columns (no household FE), Table 4 (2SLS, n_consent instrumented by treated), Table 5 (treated x pre-treatment characteristics, no month FE), final 'None -> P+S|Other' contrast block (lines 501-527: single 'after' date, groups defined by post-treatment behaviour, no unit FE). Because both cohorts are treated by August, TWFE identifies the July effect from the not-yet-treated August cohort and then compares already-treated to newly-treated households in Aug-Oct, which is exactly the setting where TWFE and CSA/BJS can diverge. With only one month of not-yet-treated comparison, CSA identifies only ATT(2018-07, t=2018-07); BJS imputation can use all pre-July observations.
estimators_reported: TWFE static (household + month FE, clustered by household)
TWFE with treatment x characteristic interactions

screener_notes: Package: ~/did_packages/mnsc/mnsc.2021.4054/data_appendix_MS-INS-19-02061/ (README.docx, replication_public.Rmd, replication_public.html, public_dataset.csv 32MB, replication-vars.xlsx). The README states the original data are under NDA and that public_dataset.csv is a SYNTHETIC dataset (10,000 synthetic households, cross-sectional white noise added, variables restricted to those in the main-text tables) that reproduces results 'qualitatively and quantitatively similar' but 'not pointwise equivalent'. Pointwise replication of the published coefficients therefore requires the authors' data; the code and synthetic data allow an approximate replication and a full TWFE/CSA/BJS comparison on the synthetic panel. Table numbers are the Rmd headings ('Table 1'..'Table 8'), which the README says correspond to the main-text tables; verify against the article. Treatment timing (two cohorts one month apart) is inferred from the synthetic data's treated variable and the code's after := month_id >= 201807; confirm with the article text that the control group was indeed solicited one month later.
